commands.name: run-structured-web
commands.description: Run a bounded, credential-free web scenario (goto, click, fill and explicit checks with role, label or text locators) in a fresh browser, optionally recording it

commands.name: run-structured-api
commands.description: Run a credential-free HTTP request with explicit status/body assertions

commands.name: prepare-scenario
commands.description: Copy the project into a persistent isolated scenario workspace and preflight the sandbox

commands.name: prepare-network-scenario
commands.description: Prepare a scenario and preflight connectivity to the specified HTTP(S) endpoint

commands.name: run-command
commands.description: Run one shell command in a prepared scenario sandbox and record a receipt; bind scenarioName to the exact requested scenario (operation completion alone is not an assertion)

commands.name: run-command-with-input
commands.description: Run one shell command in a prepared scenario sandbox with the given text as input, and record a receipt; bind scenarioName to the exact requested scenario (operation completion alone is not an assertion)

commands.name: run-structured-command
commands.description: Run one program with explicit arguments and assert its exit code and stdout, optionally recording the scenario when this one command covers it

commands.name: attest-scenario
commands.description: Explicit CLI/API tester-attested scenario completion linked to executionIds; not a machine assertion. Request: {scenarioName,result:PASS|FAIL|ERROR,executionIds:[ID,...]}
